name: HUD NSPIRE Compliance Kit WebMCP Agent Gateway
description: Structured Model Context Protocol tools for autonomous AI agents (Gemini, ChatGPT Operator, Claude in Chrome, Perplexity) to compute HUD NSPIRE physical property inspection scores, search 67-standard federal physical property defects, retrieve 24-hour emergency fixes, audit PHA jurisdiction rules, and generate statutory 48-hour tenant notices.

tools.name: calculate_nspire_score
tools.description: Compute projected HUD NSPIRE 0–100 inspection score under Title 24 CFR Part 5 and 88 FR 43380, returning PASS/FAIL status, point deductions by severity tier, inspection cycle frequency (1, 2, or 3-year), and Section 8 voucher suspension risk.

total_units.description: Total residential units at the property (default: 24)

inspected_units.description: Sample of units to be inspected by HUD (defaults to federal sampling table minimum, e.g. 5 for 24 units)

life_threatening_defects.description: Count of Life-Threatening (LT) 24-hour emergency citations found in inspected units

severe_defects.description: Count of Severe non-life-threatening citations (24-hour non-emergency repair)

moderate_defects.description: Count of Moderate severity citations (30-day repair window)

low_defects.description: Count of Low severity citations (60-day repair window)

outside_defects.description: Count of building exterior and site defects

inside_common_defects.description: Count of common interior area defects (hallways, laundry, mechanical rooms)

tools.name: lookup_nspire_defect
tools.description: Search the official 67-standard HUD NSPIRE physical inspection defect database by item name, failure description, location, or trade category to retrieve inspector criteria, failure triggers, and 5-minute landlord fixes.

query.description: Search keyword or phrase (e.g. 'GFCI', 'smoke alarm', 'water heater', 'deadbolt', 'mold', 'window', 'handrail', 'electrical panel', 'peeling paint', 'dryer vent')

category.description: Filter by HUD NSPIRE standard category (default: 'all')

tools.name: get_life_threatening_fails
tools.description: Retrieve the complete Top 25 Immediate Life-Threatening (24-Hour) HUD NSPIRE Emergency Failures that trigger mandatory 24-hour repair notices and threaten immediate Section 8 voucher rent abatement.

tools.name: get_compliance_kit_tiers
tools.description: Retrieve pricing, package deliverables, included templates, and direct download links for the HUD NSPIRE Compliance Kit packages ($47 Quick-Check Defense, $97 Landlord Audit Vault, $197 Property Manager Multi-Unit Hub).

tools.name: get_pha_jurisdiction_rules
tools.description: Query specific inspection policies, statutory 24-hour proof submission portals, Section 8 voucher payment guidelines, and contact protocols for the top 20 Public Housing Authorities (AHA, NYCHA, CHA, DHA, HACLA, etc.).

query.description: Housing Authority name, PHA code (e.g. GA006, NY005, IL002, TX009), city, or two-letter state code

tools.name: generate_48hr_tenant_notice
tools.description: Generate a compliant statutory 48-hour pre-inspection tenant entry notice letter meeting Title 24 CFR Part 5 and local landlord-tenant statutes, including mandatory bedroom egress clearance rules, smoke detector tampering warnings, and pet restraint instructions.

tenant_name.description: Full name of resident (optional, defaults to 'Resident')

property_address.description: Full property street address, city, state, zip

inspection_date.description: Scheduled date of HUD NSPIRE inspection (e.g. 'Tuesday, October 14, 2026')

arrival_window.description: Estimated inspector arrival window (e.g. '9:00 AM – 1:00 PM')

tools.name: dispatch_emergency_handyman_rfq
tools.description: Dispatch an urgent statutory 24-hour repair work order and RFQ to verified local maintenance technicians and emergency handymen for cited HUD NSPIRE life-safety defects, generating photo-proof checklists and locking in emergency response.

property_address.description: Full street address of the property requiring emergency repair

contact_name.description: Property manager or owner contact name

contact_phone.description: Immediate callback telephone number for contractor

defects_summary.description: List of defect items to remedy (e.g. ['GFCI outlet within 6ft of kitchen sink', 'Water heater TPR relief discharge pipe missing', 'Sealed 10-year smoke alarm needed in front hallway'])
